review_scope: Fresh read-only re-review of Notes CDP startup diagnostic activation and instrumentation; no authorship.

prior_findings.finding: The original diagnostic had no valid Notes A activation route because the SEO diagnostic was scoped to guest SEO.
prior_findings.evidence: Workflow now defines default-false notes_startup_diagnostic; admission allows it only for notes-find-member/A; the runner maps the Notes input to MATRX_CDP_STARTUP_DIAGNOSTIC and its native harness callsite. Focused route tests pass enabled and disabled routing and reject other cases/lanes.

prior_findings.finding: The first peer's B verdict was PARTIAL pending this activation repair.
prior_findings.evidence: The route test parses workflow YAML, executes the admission shell, evaluates the workflow env expression, evaluates runner childEnv/driver source, and reaches the real harness callsite with the observer.

findings.detail: This review verifies that an authorized Notes A run can activate the diagnostic, but no hosted run was launched and no live Chrome failure phase was observed. The experiment therefore remains unconfirmed as a diagnosis of the original incident.

checks.safety_review: Source inspection found existing startup deadlines and connector timeout/cleanup behavior unchanged; no retry or guard widening. Probe starts after connector ownership validation and is destroyed when the connector settles. Receipt contains fixed phase names, durations, counts, and bounded integer HTTP status only; no URL/port/path, headers, body, credentials, process arguments, or exception text. SEO CPU diagnostics retain their previous mapping; the CDP probe is separately controlled.
